## Invitations

A total of 6920 people were invited. Of these, 4575 attended, giving an attendance rate of 66.1. The figures provide a clear summary of invitation and attendance outcomes. Attendance is reported against the number invited, allowing the response to be considered in a consistent way.

The attendance figure is presented alongside the invitation total and the reported rate. This records both the number of people who attended and the proportion represented by that number. The information is retained in a concise format for review and routine reporting.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0. Reminders were also recorded as 0. These figures indicate that no SMS messages or reminders are included in the contact record.

The contact information is reported separately from attendance so that invitation activity, attendance, and follow-up activity can be considered distinctly. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
